card.name: Sentence-ending periods in general prose
card.fires_on: Mostly the period ending a long sentence in general web prose (history, ethics, politics, literature). Also fires on a leading digit '2' at the start of a number such as 215 or 2007.

modes.label: Sentence-final period
modes.description: Full stop closing a long, abstract sentence in essay-style text.
